ok but tell me why my “i don’t feel like cooking” meal turns out better than when i actually try 😅

this is my go-to when i want something cozy without the effort. one pot, no chaos, and somehow it always hits.

little splash of white wine (don’t skip it), sausage, noodles, broccoli, broth, parmesan… let it do its thing and that’s literally it.

also… can we talk about how good this pot looks on the stove?? like she’s doing her job and serving looks.

comes out so good, and somehow even better the next day (which feels illegal for how easy it is)

save this for your next lazy night
